arxiv-2110-00174.title: Empirical Quantitative Analysis of COVID-19 Forecasting Models
arxiv-2110-00174.creator: Anonymous, Yun Zhao * 2 , Yuqing Wang * 2 , Junfeng Liu 2 , Haotian Xia 2 , Zhenni Xu 2 , Qinghang Hong 2 , Zhiyang Zhou 3 , Linda Petzold 2
arxiv-2110-00174.description: Abstract COVID-19 has been a public health emergency of international concern since early 2020. Reliable forecasting is critical to diminish the impact of this disease. To date, a large number of different forecasting models have been proposed, mainly including statistical models, compartmental models, and deep learning models.

arxiv-2202-03047.title: Data set creation and Empirical analysis for detecting signs of depression from social media postings
arxiv-2202-03047.creator: Kayalvizhi S, Thenmozhi D
arxiv-2202-03047.description: Abstract Depression is a common mental illness that has to be detected and treated at an early stage to avoid serious consequences. There are many methods and modalities for detecting depression that involves physical examination of the individual. However, diagnosing mental health using their social media data is more effective as it avoids such physical examinations.

arxiv-2307-11677.title: Improved Approximate Distance Oracles: Bypassing the Thorup-Zwick Bound in Dense Graphs
arxiv-2307-11677.creator: Davide Bilò, Shiri Chechik, Keerti Choudhary, Sarel Cohen, Tobias Friedrich, Martin Schirneck
arxiv-2307-11677.description: Abstract Despite extensive research on distance oracles, there are still large gaps between the best constructions for spanners and distance oracles. Notably, there exist sparse spanners with a multiplicative stretch of 1 + ε 1+\varepsilon plus some additive stretch. A fundamental open problem is whether such a bound is achievable for distance oracles as well.

arxiv-2510-03654.title: A Novel, Steerable, Low-Energy Proton Source for Detector Characterization Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods A
arxiv-2510-03654.creator: Nicholas Macsai, August Mendelsohn, David Harrison, Russell Mammei, Michael Gericke, Leah Broussard, Erick Smith, Grant Riley, Glenn Randall, Mark Makela
arxiv-2510-03654.description: Abstract We report on the conversion of the Manitoba II mass spectrometer into a versatile proton beam facility. This infrastructure is adaptable to any detector-under-test (DUT), and has proven itself effective with the characterization of silicon detectors used in subatomic beyond-the-Standard-Model (BSM) searches.

britannica-1911-joachim-joseph.title: Joachim, Joseph (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-joachim-joseph.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-joachim-joseph.description: Article 'Joachim, Joseph' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was born at Kittsee, near Pressburg, on the 28th of June 1831, the son of Jewish parents. His family moved to Budapest when he was two years old, and he studied there under Serwaczynski, who brought him out at a concert when he was only eight years old. Afterwards he learnt from the elder Hellmesberger and Joseph Böhm in Vienna, the latter instructing him in the management of the bow.

britannica-1911-tibullus-albius.title: Tibullus, Albius (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tibullus-albius.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tibullus-albius.description: Article 'Tibullus, Albius' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Besides the poems themselves—that is to say, the first and second books—we have only a few references in later writers and a short Life of doubtful authority. We do not know his praenomen; his gentile name has been questioned; nor is his birthplace ascertained. His station was not improbably that of a Roman knight (so the Life affirms); and he had inherited a very considerable estate.

pmc-11366781.title: The Effect of Hypertonic Saline Nebulization on Arterial Blood Gas Parameters Among Patients on a Mechanical Ventilator
pmc-11366781.creator: Saraswathi M, Priyadharsini Masilamani, Kanniammal Chinnathambi
pmc-11366781.description: IntroductionCare of the airway is an essential part of the management of patients receiving mechanical ventilation. If the airway is not properly managed, an endotracheal airway can result in retained secretions, airway obstructions, and infections. These complications may prolong mechanical ventilation duration and length of hospital stay and may increase the cost of affordability.

pmc-11586042.title: The effect of preheating on microhardness and flexural strength of bulk-fill resin composites: an in-vitro study
pmc-11586042.creator: Mehdi Abed Kahnamouei, Mahmoud Bahari, Mohammad Esmaeel Ebrahimi Chaharom, Soodabeh Kimyai, Mehdi Daneshpooy, Katayoun Katebi, Bahareh Elhami
pmc-11586042.description: Purpose:The objective of this study was to assess the impact of preheating on the microhardness and flexural strength of bulk-fill resin composites.Materials and methods:In this in vitro study, forty-two specimens were prepared of each composite, X-tra fil and Opus Bulk Fill, resulting in 84 disk-shaped specimens for microhardness testing and 84 bar-shaped specimens for flexural strength analysis.

pmc-12535678.title: Bladder Injuries in Pediatric Age: A 12-Year Experience in a Tertiary Center
pmc-12535678.creator: Carolina Soares-Aquino, Domingas Atouguia, Angélica Osório, Carlos Mariz, Miguel Campos, Leonor Carmo
pmc-12535678.description: Introduction: Bladder injuries are rare in pediatric age. They occur mainly after blunt trauma, frequently in motor vehicle accidents with a fastened seatbelt. When full, the bladder is more prone to rupture, and the dome is the most affected place.

pmc-12582720.title: Different aspects of pharmacological heart failure treatment
pmc-12582720.creator: Stefan Agewall
pmc-12582720.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). iotensin–Neprilysin Inhibition in Admitted Patients with Worsening Heart Failure (PREMIER) study, which investigated the impact of initiating Sac/Val during hospitalization for AHF on echocardiographic parameters over an 8-week period, in comparison with the standard renin–angiotensin system inhibitor therapy.1

The study group concluded that in patients stabilized after hospitalization for AHF, Sac/Val may significantly improve some functional and structural parameters of the left ventricle, particularly in those with an LVEF < 40%, supporting its role as an effective therapy for reverse remodelling.

pmc-12610133.title: RNA Sequencing and Metabolomic Analyses Reveal Differences in Muscle Characteristics and Metabolic Profiles Between Purebred and Crossbred Huainan Pigs
pmc-12610133.creator: Jing Wang, Yufu Li, Mengyang Zhang, Junfeng Chen, Qingxia Lu, Hanbing Zhang, Xiangzhou Yan, Chuanying Pan, Xuelian Zhang, Baosong Xing
pmc-12610133.description: Simple SummaryThis study aimed to enhance the low lean meat yield and slow growth rate of Huainan (HN) pigs through crossbreeding, resulting in three hybrid combinations (BH, LH, and YH) by mating HN pigs with Berkshire, Landrace, and Yorkshire pigs, respectively. Offspring were assessed for muscle characteristics, and the longissimus dorsi (LD) muscle underwent extensive transcriptomic and metabolomic evaluations.

pmc-13119013.title: SARS-CoV-2 Effects on Respiratory and Neurological Systems: Morphological Findings and Gene Expression in K18-hACE2 Mice Model
pmc-13119013.creator: Ana Luisa Teixeira de Almeida, Andréa Marques Vieira da Silva, Mariana Mello e Souza, Miguel Pires Medeiros Diniz Rodrigues, Felipe Soares Coelho, Lorenna Carvalho da Rosa, Tamiris Azamor, Carolina Baeta Salvador Várady, Bruno Jorge Duque da Silva, Alex Costa de Almeida, Renata Tourinho Santos, Rodr
pmc-13119013.description: The COVID-19 pandemic, caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), has revealed a complex interplay between respiratory and neurological manifestations. This study utilized K18-hACE2 transgenic mice to investigate the morphological, ultrastructural, and transcriptomic changes induced by SARS-CoV-2 infection in both lungs and brain tissues.

pmc-13275018.title: GatorSC: multi-scale cell and gene graphs with mixture-of-experts fusion for single-cell transcriptomics
pmc-13275018.creator: Yuxi Liu, Zhenhao Zhang, Mufan Qiu, Song Wang, Flora D Salim, Jun Shen, Tianlong Chen, Imran Razzak, Fuyi Li, Jiang Bian
pmc-13275018.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables high-resolution characterization of cellular heterogeneity, but its rich, complementary structure across cells and genes remains underexploited, especially in the presence of technical noise and sparsity. Effectively leveraging this multi-scale structure is essentially an information fusion problem that requires integrating heterogeneous graph-based views of cells and genes into robust low-dimensional representations.

pmc-13320468.title: APOE Genotype Modifies the Predictive Performance of Plasma Biomarkers for Amyloid Plaque Burden in Subjective Cognitive Decline
pmc-13320468.creator: Hyuk-je Lee, Bora Yoon, Yun Jeong Hong, Jee Hyang Jeong, SangYun Kim, Min Jeong Wang, Seong Hye Choi, Ji Sun Ryu, Sungmin Kang, Kee Hyung Park, Dong Won Yang
pmc-13320468.description: BackgroundApolipoprotein E (APOE) ε4 is a well-known risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease (AD), with ε4 carriers exhibiting distinct clinical and biological characteristics compared to non-carriers. This study investigated whether the predictive performance of plasma biomarkers for amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) outcomes varies by APOE ε4 carrier status in individuals with subjective cognitive decline (SCD).

pmc-13332728.title: Impact of a Multi-Component Preventive Oral Health Program on Dental Plaque Scores for Individuals with Special Health Care Needs
pmc-13332728.creator: Wejdan Saad Alrazooq, Sultana A Alhurishi, Altaf H Shah
pmc-13332728.description: PurposePlaque accumulation is considered to be one of the main factors in various oral diseases. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of oral health counselling on plaque scores for Individuals with Special Health Care Needs (ISHCN) attending special care dentistry clinics.

pmc-13402722.title: From Raw Hospital Records to an AI-Ready Surveillance Dataset: A FAIR-Compliant Data Pipeline for Healthcare-Associated Infection Research in a Chinese District Hospital
pmc-13402722.creator: Dan Han, Xin Shu, Yang Hu, Hao Zou, Chong Wang, Xu Peng

pmc-13478518.title: Electrolyte additive screening for co-regulation of solvation and solid electrolyte interphase in aqueous zinc batteries
pmc-13478518.creator: Shaocong Tang, Jiabao Li, Tian Wang, Tianyi Wang, Weiwei Xiang, Ya Xiao, Hong Mu Park, Shenqiu Xu, Jae Su Yu, Huan Pang
pmc-13478518.description: The development of aqueous zinc metal batteries is hindered by dendritic growth, parasitic side reactions, and unstable electrode-electrolyte interface, leading to rapid capacity fading. To address these issues, we rationally screen and identify a pair of complementary additives, methyl propionate and L-cysteine, to synergistically regulate zinc ion solvation structure and interfacial chemistry.

pmc-13573798.title: Effects of Acetylcholine on Endothelial Function and Nitric Oxide Levels in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Study
pmc-13573798.creator: Ibrahim Ismail Abuzaid, Hassan M Abdelnour, Abdulmajeed R Almalty, Nermeen K Bleedy, Sobhy Mahmoud Aly, Mahmoud Sabry Asal, Abdelrazak A Ahmed, Reham Abdelrazek
pmc-13573798.description: BackgroundPeripheral neuropathy is a prevalent neurological disorder with multiple etiologies. Nerve damage frequently occurs due to prolonged high blood sugar levels and diabetes. Peripheral nerve fiber impairment, mediated mainly through dysregulation of Nitric Oxide Synthase (NOS) activity, induces irreversible structural damage.
